acceptance: Retention for site-artifact and receipts is set to the period any consumer reads them, with the consumer named.
Storage measured before and two weeks after; deploys still pass end to end on the real workflow.
context: Found 2026-11-17 by the egress root-cause investigation. Site work: BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site. Guardrails: linked worktree (make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight), never the primary clone; one PR per repo; no live-cloud runs or credentials in Git or logs; heavy work only via lock-taking entry points or make heavy-run after make heavy-status; never start deliberate host load; comment policy; changelog.d fragment for user-facing change. Re-verify every cited file and line before acting; they are hints.
description:
Problem: each BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site deploy uploads site-artifact (~126 MB, 90-day retention), downloads it again (deploy.yml:84 `gh run download`, :142), uploads a ~120 MB github-pages artifact and restores a ~236 MB npm cache (setup-node cache npm, deploy.yml:57,140), about 8 deploys a day. Site Actions storage grew from 73.9 to 105.7 GB between 2026-11-01 and 2026-11-16. Egress estimate 5-15 GB/day [inference].

Outcome: retention matches how long the artifact is read, the build output is not re-downloaded where a job can pass it directly, and the npm cache is restored only by jobs that run npm.
